zh: 印度土邦女邦主；印度邦主（或王公）之妻
en: an Indian queen; the wife of a raja
the position, especially a high position, that somebody has in a particular organization, society, etc.
ex: She was not used to mixing with people of high social rank.
她不习惯和社会地位很高的人交往。

en: a method for finding to what extent two sets of numbers, each arranged in order, are connected or have an effect on each other
RHM

zh: 地位，排名，排位（尤指在体育运动中）
（某项体育运动的）最佳运动员排名表
en: the position of somebody/something on a scale that shows how good or important they are in relation to other similar people or things, especially in sport
ex: He has improved his ranking this season from 67th to 30th.
本赛季他将自己的排名从第 67 位提高到了第 30 位。

zh: 使人耿耿于怀（或怨恨不已、痛苦不已）
en: if something such as an event or a remark rankles, it makes you feel angry or upset for a long time
ex: Her comments still rankled.
她的评价仍然让人耿耿于怀。

zh: 洗劫；（为找东西）把…翻腾得乱七八糟
en: to make a place untidy, causing damage, because you are looking for something
ex: Burglars ransacked her home.
盗贼把她家洗劫一空。

en: money that is paid to somebody so that they will set free a person who is being kept as a prisoner by them
ex: The kidnappers demanded a ransom of £50 000 from his family.
绑架者向他的家人索要赎金 5 万英镑。

zh: 勒索软件，敲诈软件（封锁用户的计算机系统，付钱后方解封）
en: a type of software that is designed to block access to a computer system until a sum of money is paid
ex: The criminals behind this particular ransomware attack demanded $192 from users to unlock their computer systems.
这种特定勒索软件攻击背后的犯罪分子要求用户解锁192美元的计算机系统。

en: to speak or complain about something in a loud and/or angry way
ex: She was ranting on about the unfairness of it all.
她在抱怨这一切的不公平。

zh: （长时间的）怒气冲冲的厉声斥责
en: loud or angry comments or speeches that continue for a long time

zh: 说唱音乐（节奏快而强，配有快速念白的流行音乐）
en: a quick, sharp hit or knock
ex: There was a sharp rap on the door.
有人在重重地急促敲门。

zh: a record kept by the police of the crimes that somebody has committed
en: a record kept by the police of the crimes that somebody has committed
ex: She has an extensive rap sheet.
她的说唱内容丰富。

en: wanting more money or goods than you need or have a right to
ex: He describes the world of finance as ‘a casino full of rapacious capitalists’.
他将金融世界描述为“一个充满贪婪的资本家的赌场”。
